tools.name: extract_coi
tools.description: Read an ACORD 25 Certificate of Insurance into structured data (spec §3.1). Returns a signed envelope.

tools.name: check_carrier
tools.description: Verify an insurer by NAIC code or name: known, licensed, and adequately rated (spec §3.3). Answers from an UNVERIFIED seed dataset (§4.5 datasetStatus) and returns a signed envelope.

tools.name: validate_coi
tools.description: Extract an ACORD 25 certificate AND judge it against a requirement profile (inline or profileId), returning a signed Verdict with per-check results, flags, and a risk score (spec §3.2).
